title: The Migration in January and February
excerpt: In January and February the migration herds are in the southern Serengeti and Ndutu. The calving season makes it one of the best times for predators.
body:
In January and February, the herds of the migration are usually on the short-grass plains of the southern Serengeti and the Ndutu area.

## Calving

The calving season usually peaks around February, when a very large number of calves are born in a short period. See [Ndutu and the calving season](/blog/ndutu-calving-season/).

## Predators

Lions, cheetahs, hyenas and jackals are drawn to the herds. Hunts are common.

## Weather

This is the short dry spell between rains. Mostly sunny, sometimes afternoon showers, green plains.

## Where to stay

Mobile camps in the Ndutu area and lodges near Lake Ndutu and Lake Masek.

## Combine

With central Serengeti, Ngorongoro and Tarangire. Also a good time to climb Kilimanjaro.

## Busy?

January and February are popular. Book in time. See [when to book](/blog/when-to-book-safari/).

[Plan your January or February safari](/travel-proposal/).
